stem:
Jaya dips a bar magnet into a tray of pins.

Where does it pick up pins most strongly?

options.text: Along the middle of the bar, because that is the largest painted area.
Only after the magnet has been heated, which reverses the rule.
Everywhere equally, so ends do not matter.

teacher.key_rationale: A magnet attracts most strongly near its poles, not at the painted middle and not only after heating.
